rounds.method: Full-answer deterministic scan, model first review of all 342 target-family answer excerpt digests, and declared full-answer subset; model second review only where second_review.method declares it. No human audit claimed.
rounds.coverage: Evidence is frozen shared product truth and 2026-10-12 public statements; unverifiable claims stay reviewed unknown. This does not certify historical-date correctness or all competing product facts. Error unknown means target claims are not exhaustively fact-verified; it is not absence of an error.
